Our story

Why TROVEA NG

We started TROVEA NG because good clothes shouldn't cost like say na new. Every piece here is handpicked, checked over, and sold at a price that makes sense, no wahala, no shakara. We're still small, still growing, but every order gets the same care whether na your first time or your tenth.

Terms, Returns & Privacy

Returns & exchanges

Every piece is thrift and one-of-one, so we can't offer exchanges for a change of mind. If what arrives is significantly different from what we confirmed with you, email us within 48 hours of delivery and we'll sort it out.

Delivery

Orders arrive in 5–15 days depending on your location. If it takes longer than that, you're entitled to a full refund.

Payment

Checkout sends your order to us by email. Payment is arranged after, by bank transfer or pay on delivery where available, we'll confirm the details with you directly.

Privacy

We only use your name, phone number and address to get your order to you. We don't sell or share your information with anyone else. Sign-up details are stored on your own device, not on a server we control.

Questions

Reach us anytime at temaamarateddy2005@gmail.com.
